title: crap
text:
crap. Hmm... Super lightweight... and the "attachment" is just a peel and press sticky pad. Honestly, I'm not sure it will hold more than 2 bananas. I am having some cabinet work done so I am waiting to attach... but I may not do it.
It arrived quickly and in good condition, I have prime. I will update with any new news or changes my opinion.
UPDATE: .... As predicted... it didn't stay up. Set on smooth under cabinet material... left overnight... then put up 3 small bananas, certainly smaller than the bananas shown in the photo. 20 minutes later, it fell. I think it would be better to find something a bit more sturdy or screw in... or go with the counter top version. If there is anything more I can do to provide helpful info, let me know.
